name: amonhen
description: A personal extension for working with Git comfortably in VSCode, on the Amon Hen engine

amonhen.daemon.enabled.markdownDescription: Use the shared daemon of Amon Hen’s engine (the same as the standalone app’s, bundled with the extension) for History, diffs and operations. It shares History, the search index and the Undo log with the app and the CLI. When off, the extension runs on its own git execution layer. Without an engine for this host’s OS and CPU, it runs on the git execution layer whatever this says.

amonhen.daemon.path.markdownDescription: Where the engine (`amonhen`) to use instead of the bundled one is. When empty, the bundled one is installed in `~/.local/share/amonhen` and used.
